trace.title: Compose project
trace.detail: Compose describes a multi-container application. Services can reach one another by service name on their configured network. localhost inside a container refers to that container, not the database next door or your host browser.

trace.title: Follow one item
trace.detail:
Compose creates network/services → database becomes healthy → schema setup completes → web/dispatch/consumer start → service DNS connects internal calls → published port serves the browser.

Inspect logs and exit status per service. Rebuilding an image does not necessarily replace every running service unless the chosen command does so. State what the command will change.

trace.title: Try the failure
trace.detail: Using localhost for db from web points at the wrong container. Removing volumes erases local lab data. A started DB process may still be initializing or lack the schema.
